O owner decision · P proposed · S sourced · M photo-measured · E estimated · D derived · G gear.py. s < 0 = main inboard (brake) side.
matte dusty / satin / dark; NO lettering
leg-door blue (3008), a shade darker, soft coat
bright satin cast alu / heat-dark steel
dark steel nut + tear-drop lock plate (nose)
adjacent parts, free tyre, TRA env.
Drawn from the parameter tables of model/wheels.py (PTable: value + source tag + note): tyre envelopes MAIN_TYRE_ENV / NOSE_TYRE_ENV, sections, rims, fairing, brake, axles; never from the mesh. Axle
positions and the gear context (trailing arm, leg, shock, nose fork) from model/gear.py, drawn as adjacent parts (phantom). Photos and their measurement working stay in the git-ignored refs/cache.

First-angle projection. Each assembly: SIDE view from port (principal), FRONT view from ahead to its right (upper half in section through the axle), TOP view from above below it; for the main wheel also view C from
starboard (inboard / brake face) at the far right. Each group's side / front views stand on one ground line.
MAIN TYRE - modelled 8.50-10 Type III, OWNER DECISION 2026-09-26 (tyre makers, parts lists, four photo methods; TRA OD 627-652, drawn free OD 640); Jane's / Pilatus drawing 22x8.50-10 (OD 559),

superseded, shown in the accent colour. Axles and static stance kept: axle WL 279 = the loaded radius, the tyre flat on the ground over a 250 mm patch and across the tread width (41 mm deflection) with a 6 mm
sidewall bulge. Nose tyre loaded too: axle WL 207 (photos 200-210), 130 mm patch, 15.5 mm deflection.

3-D model: gear.MAIN_TYRE = this envelope (R 320.0); the leg door's tyre blister (10 clear, model judging r1) and the round well (bays.WELL_R) follow it. model/wheels.py main_wheel / nose_wheel revolve / extrude
the profiles of this sheet (tyre with the grooves, wheel halves, hub fairing, brake, valve, tie bolts); test/consistency_2d3d.py (L4W) compares the mesh with them.

Tyre section: tangent arcs - crown R to the tread half-width, shoulder round, upper sidewall (radius solved: tangent to the shoulder, max width W/2 at 0.50 H), lower sidewall with the moulded rim-protector step (17 / 13
above the flange tip) to where the tyre leaves the rim-flange tip round. At the TRA max shoulder width the modelled section is Ø578.6, inside the TRA max Ø578.9.

Main hub fairing (POH: fairings on the outer hubs), painted in the leg-door colour; its face stands 9 mm outboard of the tyre's max width; retracted (wheel tilted with the skin) it lies 16.0 mm below the skin, inside the

Main brake: six pistons, three retractors, steel friction surfaces, bolted to the axle (POH 7-4-10); 3 rotors / 2 stators inferred from the overhaul kit (24 pads, 2 stators, 48 rivets). Housing, stack and torque tube sized
inside the inboard wheel half [E]; one piston lobe is shown in section.

No markings (owner decision): no sidewall lettering, brand names or placards on wheels or tyres. The tread grooves are geometry (the render-time groove shader is off). Screw, valve and tie-bolt clocking is the drawn
pose (the wheels turn); starboard units are mirror images. The main leg door (LD-1) is not shown.
